privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lede: This Privacy Policy explains how Connex handles personal information in connection with the Connex service. It reflects our obligations under Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI).

operator.b:
Connex is operated by [legal entity name] ("Connex", "we", "us"), [registered address], represented by [representative name].

This policy describes how we handle personal information when you use the Connex service (the "Service").

role.h: Our role: provider and entrustee (委託先)
role.b:
Connex is a multi-tenant SaaS. For the CRM records our customers enter about their own contacts, the customer is the business operator handling that personal information under the APPI, and Connex handles it as an entrustee (委託先) strictly on the customer's instructions and within the scope of our agreement.

This policy covers Connex's own handling of personal information. Each customer is responsible for the privacy notices it gives to its own data subjects.

data.b:
- Account and profile data you provide: name, email, authentication credentials such as passkeys, and your workspace and role.
- Usage and technical data generated when you use the Service: IP address, browser / user-agent, session identifiers, audit-log events, and timestamps.
- Customer content: as an entrustee, we store and process the CRM records our customers enter, which may include third parties' names, contact details, employment history, activities, notes, and relationship information.

assistantSessions.b: Assistant sessions are workspace data. While the author remains an active member, a session not marked shared is inaccessible to other members, including workspace administrators. If the author leaves the workspace or deletes their account, the session is retained and becomes accessible to workspace administrators who hold the assistant-oversight permission, including when the session was not marked shared. These administrative reads are recorded in the audit log, and administrators cannot modify a retained session.

entrustment.b:
We entrust parts of our processing to subprocessors that support the Service, such as cloud infrastructure hosting, and we supervise them as the APPI requires.

Personal data for the SaaS is stored on cloud infrastructure located in Japan. A current list of subprocessors is available on request via the contact point below.

thirdParty.b:
We do not sell personal information. We do not provide it to third parties except: with your consent; where a customer directs sharing within the Service; to subprocessors under entrustment as described above; or where required by law.

Sharing features within the Service operate only within a customer's own organization, at the customer's direction.

crossBorder.b: We store SaaS personal data in Japan. Where any handling involves a party located outside Japan, we act in accordance with the APPI's rules on provision to third parties in foreign countries, and we make available information about the country concerned and its data-protection environment (外的環境の把握).

security.b:
We take organizational, human, physical, and technical security control measures appropriate to the risk. These include role-based access control, tenant isolation, an append-only audit log, encrypted transport, and hardened authentication (including passkeys / WebAuthn).

A fuller summary is set out on our Data Disclosure page.

retention.b:
We retain personal information only as long as necessary to provide the Service and to meet legal, accounting, and security obligations, and we delete or anonymize it when it is no longer required.

Customer content is retained per the customer's agreement. On termination we provide an export and then delete customer data within the period set out in that agreement.

rights.b:
Subject to the APPI, you may request disclosure, correction / addition / deletion, cease of use or erasure, and cease of third-party provision of your retained personal data, as well as disclosure of records of third-party provision.

Where Connex handles data only as an entrustee, please direct your request to the customer that is the handling operator; we will support that customer as required. For data for which Connex is the operator, contact us using the details below. We may need to verify your identity before responding.

cookies.b: The Service uses strictly necessary cookies for authentication and session management, and a cookie that remembers your language preference. We do not use advertising cookies.

breach.b: If a reportable personal-data breach occurs, we act under our breach-response procedure: we promptly notify affected customers and support notification to the Personal Information Protection Commission (個人情報保護委員会) and to affected individuals as required by the APPI.

changes.b: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be indicated by updating the "last updated" date and, where appropriate, by notice within the Service.

contact.b: For questions or requests regarding personal information, contact our personal-information contact point at privacy@[domain] (attention: [privacy manager / 個人情報保護管理者]), [registered address].

disclosure.lede: This page sets out the matters concerning retained personal data that Connex makes publicly available under Article 32 of Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI). It complements our Privacy Policy.

operator.b:
Name: [legal entity name].
Address: [registered address].
Representative: [representative name].

manager.b: [Privacy manager name or title (個人情報保護管理者)], reachable at privacy@[domain].

purpose.h: 3. Purpose of use of all retained personal data

assistantSessions.b: Assistant sessions are workspace data. Sessions not marked shared remain inaccessible to other members, including workspace administrators, while their author is an active workspace member. If the author leaves the workspace or deletes their account, the sessions are retained and become accessible to workspace administrators who hold the assistant-oversight permission, including sessions not marked shared. Each such administrative read is recorded in the audit log, and administrators cannot modify the retained session.

procedure.h: 5. Procedures for disclosure and other requests (開示等の請求)
procedure.b:
You may request disclosure, correction / addition / deletion, cease of use or erasure, cease of third-party provision, and disclosure of third-party-provision records of your retained personal data.

Send requests to the contact point in section 2. We will verify the requester's identity, respond without undue delay in the manner prescribed by the APPI, and inform you of any prescribed fee before proceeding. Where Connex holds the data only as an entrustee, we will refer the request to the customer that is the handling operator.

security.b:
We have taken the following categories of security control measures:

- Organizational: defined responsibilities, access management, and an append-only audit log of access to and changes of personal data.
- Human: staff supervision and confidentiality obligations.
- Physical: reliance on cloud infrastructure with physical-security controls.
- Technical: role-based access control, tenant isolation, encrypted transport, hardened authentication (passkeys / WebAuthn), and security headers.
- External environment: SaaS personal data is stored on cloud infrastructure located in Japan; where handling involves parties outside Japan, we take account of that country's data-protection environment.

complaints.b:
Complaints about our handling of personal data may be made to the contact point in section 2. You may also contact the Personal Information Protection Commission (個人情報保護委員会).

[Connex is not currently a member of an authorized personal-information protection organization (認定個人情報保護団体).]

external.h: 8. Grasp of the external environment (外的環境の把握)
external.b:
Where retained personal data is stored or handled outside Japan, we identify the relevant country and take account of its personal-data protection framework in our safeguards.

SaaS data is currently stored in Japan. [Name any country and provider here if applicable.]

You are responsible for having a lawful basis and any required consents to collect and use that data, and for the privacy notices your own data subjects require.
